opening.argument: The presentation directly promotes participation in a token-based mining scheme by linking the submission of tokens to mining OneCoins for the viewer: “submitting your tokens to OneCoin so they can start mining OneCoins for you.” It further promises that “Immediately after the split, the number will double,” presenting a specific return associated with participation. This is not merely a description of the platform: viewers are told to enter a token amount and “click submit,” while being urged to act immediately after a split to avoid delay. The displayed mining interface reinforces that operational appeal with a “YOU ARE MINING” status, a claimed share of coins, and a submission control. The speaker also directs viewers to share the video with team members, actively encouraging wider participation in the scheme.
